abilities.effect: All creatures in the trap’s 10-foot square take 2d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save).
abilities.name: Deadfall
abilities.trigger: A creature steps into the square with the web tripwire.

hazard.description: A web tripwire lets loose a bundle of boulders that fall on all targets within a 10-foot square.
hazard.disable: Survival (trained) or Thievery (expert) DC 20 to rearrange the webbing
hazard.name: Web Lurker Deadfall

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
